name: next-steps
description: Next Steps — post-consultation care coordination for RSSDI clinics, on the OpenPHC Care Coordination Engine.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @next-steps/admin && npm run build -w @next-steps/doctor
scripts.build:hosting: npm run build -w @next-steps/admin && npm run build -w @next-steps/doctor -- --base=/doctor/ && npm run build -w @next-steps/maternal -- --base=/maternal/ && node scripts/assemble-hosting.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @next-steps/core && npm run typecheck -w @next-steps/admin && npm run typecheck -w @next-steps/doctor && npm run typecheck -w @next-steps/maternal
